## Summary

Describe the problem and the change. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. Include sanitised screenshots for UI changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and include relevant tests.
- [ ] Related documentation is updated.
- [ ] User-facing text is available in English and Spanish, if applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, real inventory data or sensitive screenshots are included.

For vulnerabilities, use private reporting as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
